limits: Native receiver route/router/control dispatch, TLS identities/pins, real authorizer implementation and real history/command stores.
Dispatcher availability and absent runtime are fixture inputs; synthetic metadata, not an approved native MCP producer/preparation/grant execution.
Host/service/coordinator fixtures have mocked policy/identity seams and are not native TLS permission proof.
Native deadline and mixed outgoing lifetime use fake timeout timers with actual queue/save/native TLS work where specified.
IO faults are injected at actual before-rename versus after-real-rename operations; ambiguous disk/cache divergence is not claimed rolled back.
Retirement before queued/postauthorization admission refuses; after admission may commit with matching memory and normal retained-history notice.
Separately admitted maintenance and retired outgoing POST lifetime remain unchanged; no global zero-write or all-network-operation drain promise.
No new PR/CI/hosted-E2E execution; exact independent implementation/proof review remains pending.
Original fixture failures, candidate failures and gate refusal are preserved; failed-assertion downstream checks are uncredited.
